extension.name: Door-Sync CiviRules Webhook
extension.description: CiviRules action that POSTs an HMAC-signed webhook to the door-webhook Cloudflare Worker when a membership changes, driving near-real-time door-access reconciliation in door-sync.
extension.comments: Requires the CiviRules extension (org.civicoop.civirules). Set the Worker URL and HMAC secret at Administer > System Settings > Door-Sync CiviRules Webhook Settings, or via cv (see README).
